overview: The Climate Equity Council received an update on a regional de-paving grant for West Medford, discussed rodent control and waste reduction outreach, and reviewed strategies to expand the Electrify Medford program.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events Review
items.summary: Council members reviewed upcoming community events while waiting to establish a quorum.

items.title: West Medford De-Paving MVP Grant Update
items.summary: Amanda Centrella presented an update on a regional Municipal Vulnerability Preparedness grant funding de-paving and green infrastructure design in West Medford, and members discussed community outreach partnerships.

items.title: Minutes Approval and Next Meeting Date
items.summary: The council approved the September meeting minutes and scheduled its next meeting for November 18, 2026.

items.title: Rodent Control, Waste Reduction, and Student Outreach
items.summary: The council discussed educational initiatives on rodent mitigation, composting, and proper waste disposal, including social media videos created by high school volunteers.

items.title: Electrify Medford Coaching and Incentive Strategies
items.summary: Staff presented ideas to revitalize the Electrify Medford program, including recruiting youth language coaches and providing micro-grants or tangible energy-efficiency incentives to residents.
